_about: Held-item fragment (List 19 #183) — trigger resolution for #31's held layer, the slot #166's drops fill and #109's validator reads. One hook per item; effect VALUES are #31 item data and none are set here. The shared trigger order (acting side first; within a side, abilities before held items) is stated identically in #184 — the two specs state it from their own sides and agree.

model.consumption: the 'consumed' modifier on any trigger class: when the effect fires, the item is spent (a queue-announced battle event); at battle end the held slot on the individual record is empty. Unmodified items persist
model.hook: a single {triggerClass, effectTarget} on the item's #31 record; effectTarget names a #17 pipeline stage or a #10 queue behaviour. Two hooks on one item = data error (checker-class). No hook = inert in battle
model.slotInBattle: fixed at entry — no equip/swap command exists (#10's ring; #165's bag reads useContext.battle, a different field); no canon effect moves a held item between individuals, and no seat for one is provided
model.thresholdRearm: a threshold effect fires once per crossing and re-arms only after the fact leaves the zone

triggerClasses.on-dealt: at hit resolution; effect emits immediately after that hit's damage queue item
triggerClasses.on-taken: at hit resolution; effect emits immediately after that hit's damage queue item
triggerClasses.standing: continuous while held; composes in #17's chain at the named stage
triggerClasses.threshold: fires when a stated battle fact crosses a stated threshold (fact + threshold are item data)

model.triggerOrder: at a single trigger point: acting side before receiving side; within a side, abilities (#184) before held items (#183). Field modifiers are not triggered effects (they compose in #17's [field] stage per #181)

open_register: every held item's existence, hook, and effect values (#31 data + owner balance pass)
whether any item carries the consumed modifier (item data)
the threshold facts/thresholds any item uses (item data)
